decision.rationale: I am declining this dispute because the records show two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 10 days after the disputed charge posted on 2026-10-20. That is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). There are two charges at FERNHILL APOTHECARY (MER-000067) on card CRD-000049, both for 4407 EUR minor units and both posted on 2026-10-20: TXN-008099 at 2026-10-19T16:31:45Z under AUTH-008289, and the disputed TXN-008100 at 2026-10-19T20:31:45Z under AUTH-008290. The two charges have different authorisations. Both were approved contactless payments, made four hours apart, with no fraud flag. No refund for either charge appears on the card. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two charges with their own authorisations made some time apart are two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same.

proposed_actions.reason: There are two 44.07 EUR charges from FERNHILL APOTHECARY on 2026-10-19, but each was approved separately as its own contactless card payment, about four hours apart (16:31 and 20:31 UTC). Our records show these as two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice. If you made only one of these payments, you can open a new dispute saying that you did not make or allow the other one.
